PCA-001.note: One result per selected action in catalogue order; unknown IDs are reported in ignoredSelection and never run.

PCA-003.note: The engine tracks the working media by the last successful transformation; ActionExecutor owns the media and must not touch it on failure.

PCA-004.note: Native file/path clipboard and reveal now consume only resolved save.file; missing or failed save records dependency-skipped consumers while independent image clipboard continues. Consumer failure preserves the file/media and later independent outputs.

PCA-005.note: Native pipeline receipts retain confirmed working media and completed save artifacts after output failure/cancellation. Shared tray/main-window recovery actions open an immutable snapshot as a new unsaved editor document without consuming or rereading the saved capture. Explicit Discard/Cancel confirmation clears only the expected current in-memory receipt; saved files, clipboard contents and existing editor snapshots are preserved. Busy state, missing opener, stale approval, callback exception/reentrancy and owner destruction have private native UI/controller tests; editor tests prove exact source ownership/profile/alpha, empty durable path, cancelled Save and explicit new-file persistence. Only the latest receipt is retained in memory. Complete history/restart recovery, retention policy, remaining actions and physical/human qualification remain Required. Actual file/path clipboard and asynchronous file-manager output now preserve saved bytes and retained pixels after rejection, changed identity, missing service and unknown delivery.

PCA-006.note: Temporary file creation and cleanup are covered by platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/PostCapturePipelineTest.cpp.

PCA-007.note: Native PNG saving encodes once into an owner-private temporary file and atomically publishes through Linux RENAME_NOREPLACE. Existing files, dangling symlinks and racing writers are never replaced; collisions retry fresh random names. CaptureActions records the absolute native path, actual media type/byte length and immutable filename-generation context. Independent native tests cover exact pixels, concurrent/racing publication, private permissions, cleanup and value-free failures. Production canonical result serialization now emits the actual save artifact under a namespaced extension. Complete artifact catalogue, durable recovery, configured counter/storage integration, all save variants and native review/target qualification remain Required.

PCA-008.note: Annotation runs before save and a successful result becomes working media. Offering the re-editable document to persistence arrives with the ImageEditor.

PCA-009.note: Core selection cancellation/replacement now drives an actual native application-modal per-run chooser before save/clipboard mutation. Shared tray/main-window capture controls choose Save, Copy, both or no outputs; Cancel/Escape/default Enter/close, operation cancellation and owner destruction retain captured pixels and start no later actions. Qt Core draft validation rejects unavailable/unknown requests, while the remaining catalogue is visibly unavailable. No workflow preferences are changed; the next default capture remains Save then Copy. Full quick-task/configured workflow selection and explicit persistent editing, remaining catalogue, supported native matrix and human accessibility/privacy/parity qualification remain Required.

PCA-010.note: The same Qt Core engine runs native actions on a worker with a reachable cancellation token. Escape and Cancel Capture request cancellation while saving; an uninterruptible save may finish, records cancellation_arrived_during, and later clipboard work is cancelled. A claimed native clipboard call retains its actual outcome even if cancellation arrives during it; unclaimed calls cannot publish late. Native tests cover before-start, save/clipboard races, GUI responsiveness, destruction and actual overlay Escape. Full action catalogue and supported native matrix qualification remain Required. Native retry uses the same token and actual first-availability/owner-destruction fencing. Window Escape cancels capture/retry while modal dialogs retain Escape; retry cancellation preserves existing file/media and its durable lineage. Asynchronous native selection waits are cancellable on the worker; GUI close/destruction and admission cancellation cannot authorize late selected actions. File-output GUI claims use the same cancellable worker bridge. Unclaimed cancellation prevents mutation; a claimed ShowItems request waits for its real acknowledgement, records cancellation arrival and stops later actions. Lost acknowledgement interrupts rather than fabricating failure.

PCA-011.note: Qt Core native-scope retry planning targets only known failed or dependency-skipped save/image-clipboard actions in catalogue order, excludes successful/cancelled/other skipped actions and rejects unsupported or interrupted/unknown outcomes. The shared tray/main-window command confirms one attempt, rechecks the exact retained pixel receipt, preserves prior successful save/clipboard actions and original native settings, and executes the same worker/GUI engine. Results and journals are append-only, with original/previous task IDs, bounded integer attempt index, preserved-success provenance and true file creator metadata under the native namespace. Native/domain/private-bus and real-process kill/reopen tests verify actual PNG/clipboard retry, cancellation, stale confirmations, owner destruction, unchanged files and storage failure. Generic prerequisite/artifact/catalogue retry, upload/idempotency, cancelled-work resumption, restart media recovery, shared vectors/schema, target matrix and human reviews remain Required. Native retry now covers failed/dependency-skipped file/path clipboard and reveal. A known successful save is reused through executor-validated native identity, or the original selected failed Save is retried as prerequisite. Unselected prerequisites, successful save repetition, and uncertain reveal delivery are rejected. Shared Retry labels identify actual outputs. Generic catalogue/multiple-artifact/Save As/upload retry remain Required.

PCA-012.note: The actual native save/image-clipboard pipeline now uses a Qt Core write-ahead recorder and private atomic Linux journal. Save intent and unconfirmed publication paths precede native mutation; completed actions and canonical file facts are acknowledged afterwards. Reopened history retains completed/cancelled results and distinguishes interrupted unknown actions without retrying or inventing upload failure. Real-process kill/reopen, cancellation, storage failure, privacy/path and native review/forget fixtures verify this candidate seam. Full artifact/media recovery, retry authority, configured retention, crash-temporary cleanup, shared persisted compatibility, native target matrix and human review remain Required. Retry intent persists its new linked identity and inherited file facts before effects. Real-process tests kill linked save/clipboard attempts and recover an unchanged terminal original alongside an interrupted unknown new action. Effective per-run selections now reach the write-ahead recorder before output intent; real-process recovery preserves a successful selector and unknown chosen save without inventing deselected actions. File consumers use existing write-ahead intent. Live unknown reveal delivery stops the Core engine as interrupted without inventing an action result, leaving pending intent intact. Real-process killed file-clipboard recovery retains the acknowledged PNG and pending unknown action. Native file bindings stay in memory and are never reconstructed from restart metadata.

PCA-013.note: The engine emits stable diagnostic codes. Native capture-save encoding, publication and hook exceptions return value-free codes; private file paths and filename context remain artifact data rather than ordinary diagnostics. Complete native action privacy/diagnostic and human review coverage remain Required. The result-report serializer accepts no raster bytes, clipboard payload, recognized text or credential data; private artifact path/context appear only in user-requested review details with a privacy notice. Private native fixtures verify exception redaction and unchanged clipboard/files. Durable records accept only typed result/file metadata, exclude media and private exception payloads, and use private native storage; recovery reveals paths/context only through optional report details. Journal/private storage fixtures and candidate human-review limits are recorded in app/JOURNAL-RECOVERY.md.

PCA-014.note: One production Core runPipeline() engine serves default native capture, per-run native selection, explicit retry and conformance. The shared tray/main-window chooser returns typed outcomes to the worker engine; it creates no alternative ordering or result model. Full configured workflows, quick-task/catalogue entry-point parity and native/human qualification remain Required. The per-run chooser now enables native file/path clipboard and reveal through the same engine, result serializer and worker/GUI bridge; no shortcut creates an alternate effect path.

PCA-015.note: Core seams and native worker jobs isolate selected-action snapshots, media, files, receipts and cancellation by unique task ID. Real parallel native pipelines prove one cancelled job cannot corrupt another successful job. Configured workflow counters, temporary upload files, remaining actions and full persistence/target qualification remain Required. Per-run selection snapshots do not alter subsequent default captures; native/private-bus tests verify cancelled and accepted selection isolation.

PCA-016.note: The application native receipt and thin adapter now call one Qt Core production canonical serializer. The four published result fields and applicable action/dependency/cancellation fields remain intact; actual task identity, UTC execution times and native saved-file path/type/integer byte-length/naming context are under extensions.com.xerahs.app version 1. Native shared tray/main-window review shows an immutable read-only report without retry, file, clipboard or receipt mutations. Published vectors and independent Core/native/privacy/UI fixtures cover this seam. Canonical serialization also feeds a separate versioned write-ahead journal and native restart history for save/image-clipboard. This does not accept full recovery, retry authority, the remaining artifact catalogue, shared persisted compatibility or human/native matrix gates; those remain Required. Optional retry linkage/preserved-success provenance and file creator IDs remain namespaced; native linked result review does not invent current execution results for past successes.

PCA-017.note: The compiled catalogue is checked against actions.json by platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/PostCapturePipelineTest.cpp.

PCA-018.note: Explicit native retries can provide inherited save.file prerequisite availability without invented successful results. Actual native consumers revalidate a private owned regular file against an in-memory device/inode/size/timestamp binding at worker and GUI dispatch. Restart metadata does not supply this authority.

PCA-021.note: Core artifact bookkeeping distinguishes inherited availability from current-attempt creation. Delete is guarded for an inherited-only save even if prior consumers succeeded; published current-save deletion semantics remain intact. Native deletion is still unimplemented Required scope.

PCA-023.note: The actual native per-run chooser normalizes executor-available Save/Copy choices through the Qt Core catalogue and the same replacement engine used by published vectors. A Core hook publishes the effective full plan before recording the selector and beginning later actions, so journals and recovered results contain only chosen remaining work. Native PNG/clipboard/empty, cancellation, retry and real-process kill/reopen fixtures verify this seam. Legacy import and full configured/quick-task/catalogue UI/shared/native/human qualification remain Required.
